text:
Ana Carr: Heads-up — Nimbus on‑prem deploy window locked for Tue 2026-03-24 02:00–03:00 UTC. This includes runtime v2.1.4, KV cache tweak, and a small migration. We need: rollout owner, smoke owner, rollback lead, and network owner.
Miguel Torres: I can be rollout owner. I'll be oncall that window. Plan is canary on 3 nodes at T+5, then full if stable. :muscle:
Katie Li: I’ll take smoke tests. Checklist I'll run: health, simple generation latency, embedding consistency, and a quick rerank spot-check. Will post exact commands. :white_check_mark:
Suneel Rao: I’ll own rollback + DB migration. Migration is a no-downtime script but has a short compensating step. Rollback criteria: any 5%+ error rate on generation or >200ms median latency regression.
Jamal Brooks: Ops/network here — I’ll coordinate firewall/DNS cutover with customer. Need Nimbus L2 on call at T-15. I’ll also publish maintenance window to their portal.
deploy-bot: Maintenance page published for nimbus at 2026-03-24T01:50:00Z
Irene Park: Quick CR ping @Miguel — in the canary branch is the small-batch path disabled? I spotted config that might force batching on small traces.
Miguel Torres: @Irene good catch — I disabled small-batch in canary and merged the fix (PR #8124). Verified no perf regressions locally.
Katie Li: Smoke test commands (I'll run at +5 and +20 after canary start):
```bash
# health
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 'https://nimbus.internal/health' | jq .
# simple generation
curl -sS -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"hello"}' 'https://nimbus.internal/generate' | jq .
# embedding sanity
curl -sS -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"text":"test embedding"}' 'https://nimbus.internal/embeddings' | jq .
```
Katie Li: I'll capture latency percentiles and paste results here. If anything looks odd I'll mark rollback. :eyes:
Ana Carr: Confirm rollback steps: 1) switch traffic to fallback model v2.1.3 (routing rule), 2) revert runtime config, 3) restore DB from backup only if migration left DB inconsistent. @Suneel confirm backups.
Suneel Rao: Backup completed at 2026-03-24T01:20:00Z, checksum abc123def. Dry-run of restore successful on staging. I'll be ready to trigger restore if needed.
Jamal Brooks: Network checklist done. Customer L2 (nimbus-ops) confirmed. I also left a rollback note with them for immediate firewall revert.
Katie Li: I’ll annotate any regression items in the eval board and ping product with diffs. If embedding similarity drops >0.05 we'll consider rollback.
Ana Carr: Great. During the window please post short status updates to this thread: canary start, canary status, full rollout start, smoke pass/fail, and final done. I’ll coordinate comms externally.
deploy-bot: Reminder — run preflight `/scripts/preflight.sh nimbus` (last run 2026-03-23T22:30:00Z) — result: OK
Miguel Torres: Small note: I’ve also turned on extra logging for the runtime for +10m after canary so we can capture traces if something weird shows up. Logs go to stack with tag `nimbus-deploy-1965432100`.
Irene Park: Thanks everyone. I’ll review the canary metrics dashboard at +10 and +25. If I don't post anything it's a thumbs up. :thumbsup:
